tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Return public site identity, machine-readable endpoints and MCP endpoint information for ABC Remonty Oleba.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search published public WordPress pages/posts on oleba.pl using locality-aware service relevance. Returns canonical URLs, titles, excerpts, match diagnostics and machine-readable representation URLs.

query.description: Search phrase in Polish or another language.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Resolve a public WordPress item by numeric ID, slug or same-site URL and return Markdown/text/metadata. Password-protected, unpublished and noindex content is refused.

identifier.description: Post/page ID, slug, or canonical URL on oleba.pl.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Return the curated public Oleba service catalog as stable machine-readable service objects linked to canonical public content.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Resolve a service by stable service id or natural-language name and return its primary public page, structured price rows and related realizations.

identifier.description: Stable service id such as remont_lazienki or a service phrase such as remont łazienki.

location.description: Optional locality used to narrow related realizations.

tools.name: ask_oleba
tools.description: Compose a compact, source-linked answer bundle from the structured Oleba service catalog, public cennik, service-area evidence and realization portfolio. Deterministic and read-only: missing facts are reported, never guessed.

query.description: Optional natural-language renovation question. Used only for deterministic service/locality/filter extraction; no server-side LLM is used.

service.description: Optional stable service id or service phrase.

object_type.description: Optional structured object-type filter; unknown project values are not guessed.

initial_state.description: Optional initial condition, supported by quoted project evidence.

scope.description: Optional scope/feature phrase matched against structured scope, quoted completed work or public tags.

tag.description: Optional explicit public WordPress tag filter.

fallback_mode.description: strict_project: no alternatives; location_relaxed: relax only locality; broad: labelled legacy alternatives.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Distinguish a documented service/location offer from merely having (or not having) a published realization. Never interprets absence of public evidence as proof that Oleba refuses a locality.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Parse the public renovation cennik into structured rows. Query is optional. Returned prices are public informational ranges/amounts, not binding offers.

query.description: Optional service or price phrase, e.g. remont łazienki, malowanie, elektryka.

tools.name: get_realization
tools.description: Resolve one public realization/gallery post and return structured project metadata, evidence, media links and optional machine-readable content.

identifier.description: Realization post ID, slug or same-site canonical URL.

tools.name: get_price_information
tools.description: Find context for a service or phrase on the public Oleba renovation price-list page. Returns informational excerpts, not a binding quote.

query.description: Service or pricing phrase, e.g. remont łazienki, malowanie, gładź, elektryka.

tools.name: get_location_pages
tools.description: Find public Oleba pages/posts relevant to a locality such as Piaseczno, Ursynów, Mokotów, Józefosław or Konstancin-Jeziorna.

tools.name: get_realizations
tools.description: Search public Oleba project/gallery realization content by locality and/or topic. Generic service, local landing and price-list pages are intentionally demoted or excluded. This searches published site content only and does not access private customer records.

service.description: Optional service id or phrase, e.g. remont_lazienki, glazura, antresole_stropy.

object_type.description: Strict structured object-type filter; projects with unknown object type are omitted.

initial_state.description: Optional initial condition, supported by quoted project evidence.

scope.description: Scope/feature phrase matched against structured scope, quoted completed work or public tags.

mode.description: Legacy get_realizations keeps full as default for backwards compatibility; use compact to reduce payload.

tools.name: get_paint_calculator
tools.description: Open an interactive painting labour calculator with current public Oleba price ranges. Omit arguments to let the user fill it in. area_m2 is the measured surface of walls/ceilings being painted, NEVER the apartment floor area. Do not infer it with a multiplier. One painting type per estimate; preparation areas are independent. No materials, no inferred VAT, no binding quote. Does not edit WordPress or contact the company.

finish.description: Painting type; defaults to white. Use the same type for all surfaces in this estimate.

area_m2.description: Measured area of painted walls and/or ceilings, not floor area. Omit when unknown.

tools.name: get_renovation_calculator
tools.description: Open the interactive Oleba calculator: all 14 price-list categories, including plaster, drywall, tiles, bathroom fittings, flooring, electrical, plumbing, demolition, apartment renovation, developer finishing, decorative work, general work and mezzanines. Empty lines open the form. Call once without lines to obtain current catalog and stable service_id values; never invent IDs or prices. Quantity unit is supplied by catalog: m² of treated surface (apartment and developer categories use floor area), mb length, szt./pkt./moduł integer count. Lines may mix categories; each category is resolved from its current service_id. The top-level category only selects the initial form category. Apartment and developer allow ONE complete package, never add its included bathroom/installations again. Multiple itemised lines are allowed only when user confirms the scopes do not overlap (separate_scopes_confirmed). Prices from current public cennik; ambiguous/from/individual prices are not calculated. Labour only, no materials or inferred tax. Read-only, no booking or WordPress edits. If MCP Apps UI is unavailable, call this same tool with confirmed quantities and show the returned estimate as text: services, quantities, units, rates, labour total and assumptions. Ask for missing inputs. Never claim that UI was displayed. For clients without MCP, offer the public HTML calculator: https://oleba.pl/?oleba_calculator=1

category.description: Initial form category (default tiles). Does not restrict lines: each service_id determines its category.

separate_scopes_confirmed.description: True only after user confirms the selected lines represent separate non-overlapping work. Required for two or more lines.

tools.name: get_realizations_a2ui
tools.description: Use ONLY when an A2UI-capable host or the user explicitly requests A2UI. Returns self-contained A2UI v0.9.1 Basic Catalog messages as application/a2ui+json embedded resource, plus text links. Requires a renderer supporting this catalog and openUrl. For normal gallery requests use get_realizations (MCP Apps). Same public realization search, optional location, no writes.

service.description: Optional service id or phrase, e.g. remont_lazienki, glazura, antresole_stropy.

object_type.description: Strict structured object-type filter; projects with unknown object type are omitted.

initial_state.description: Optional initial condition, supported by quoted project evidence.

scope.description: Scope/feature phrase matched against structured scope, quoted completed work or public tags.
